title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
summary: 薄殼混凝土屋頂以數公分厚的雙曲面跨越數十公尺，靠的是形狀讓荷載以薄膜壓力傳遞；它的弱點是挫屈、邊緣彎矩、溫差裂縫與施工幾何誤差。本課從 Candela 的雙曲拋物面、Isler 的倒懸模型殼到蘇黎世聯邦理工學院在 NEST HiLo 的索網織物模板，說明殼形、配筋、模板、澆置脫模、幾何量測與長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: Thin concrete shells span tens of metres with curved surfaces only a few centimetres thick, because their form lets loads travel as membrane compression; their weak points are buckling, edge bending, thermal cracking and construction geometry errors. From Candela's hyperbolic paraboloids and Isler's inverted hanging-model shells to ETH Zurich's cable-net fabric formwork at NEST HiLo, the course explains engineering judgement on shell form, reinforcement, formwork, casting and decentering, geometry survey and long-term maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」與「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shell form and membrane action" and "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「薄膜內力」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Membrane forces” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。理想形狀下殼面幾乎全受壓，混凝土的抗壓強度被充分利用；但只要支承條件、集中荷載或邊緣不符合薄膜假設，就會在邊緣與支點附近產生彎矩擾動區。球形殼在自重下，從頂部往下經向力一直受壓，環向力則在超過某個角度後轉為受拉，因此淺殼與深殼的配筋重點完全不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「薄膜內力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does. For an ideal form the shell is almost entirely in compression, making full use of concrete's compressive strength, but wherever supports, point loads or edges violate the membrane assumptions a zone of bending disturbance appears near edges and supports. In a spherical dome under self-weight the meridional force stays compressive from crown to base, whereas the hoop force turns tensile beyond a certain angle, so shallow and deep domes need very different reinforcement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Membrane forces” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「薄膜內力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Membrane forces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用
knowledge.text: 薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。理想形狀下殼面幾乎全受壓，混凝土的抗壓強度被充分利用；但只要支承條件、集中荷載或邊緣不符合薄膜假設，就會在邊緣與支點附近產生彎矩擾動區。
knowledge.textEn: Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does. For an ideal form the shell is almost entirely in compression, making full use of concrete's compressive strength, but wherever supports, point loads or edges violate the membrane assumptions a zone of bending disturbance appears near edges and supports.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「薄殼混凝土屋頂施工」的「殼體形狀與薄膜作用：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Shell form and membrane action: mechanism and load path” in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shell form and membrane action" is correct?
options: 薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。
薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。
混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
optionsEn: Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.

Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does.
Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄膜內力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Membrane forces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa，遠低於混凝土強度。環向力 N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] 在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉，殼面延伸超過此角度就需要環向抗拉配筋或環梁。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa, far below concrete strength. The hoop force N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] turns from compression to tension at φ ≈ 51.8°, so a shell extending beyond that angle needs hoop tension reinforcement or a ring beam. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa，遠低於混凝土強度。環向力 N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] 在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉，殼面延伸超過此角度就需要環向抗拉配筋或環梁。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa, far below concrete strength. The hoop force N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] turns from compression to tension at φ ≈ 51.8°, so a shell extending beyond that angle needs hoop tension reinforcement or a ring beam. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shell form and membrane action", which statement holds?
options: 薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。
薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。
球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。
optionsEn: Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later.
Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m.
quiz.explanation: 球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄膜內力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Membrane forces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計審查時要求提交殼面薄膜力分布圖、彎矩擾動區範圍與支點推力路徑，並在圖面上標出環向受拉區與對應配筋；形狀變更（即使只是開孔或壓低矢高）都要重做整體分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At design review require plots of membrane forces, the extent of bending disturbance zones and the support thrust path, mark the hoop-tension zone and its reinforcement on the drawings, and redo the global analysis for any change of form, even a new opening or a lower rise.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。
knowledge.textEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計審查時要求提交殼面薄膜力分布圖、彎矩擾動區範圍與支點推力路徑，並在圖面上標出環向受拉區與對應配筋；形狀變更（即使只是開孔或壓低矢高）都要重做整體分析。
knowledge.textEn: At design review require plots of membrane forces, the extent of bending disturbance zones and the support thrust path, mark the hoop-tension zone and its reinforcement on the drawings, and redo the global analysis for any change of form, even a new opening or a lower rise.

quiz.question: 要驗證「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shell form and membrane action"?
options: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。
optionsEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
quiz.explanation: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄膜內力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Membrane forces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：球形殼在自重下，從頂部往下經向力一直受壓，環向力則在超過某個角度後轉為受拉，因此淺殼與深殼的配筋重點完全不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a spherical dome under self-weight the meridional force stays compressive from crown to base, whereas the hoop force turns tensile beyond a certain angle, so shallow and deep domes need very different reinforcement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。
knowledge.textEn: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shell form and membrane action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。
混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost.
Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
quiz.explanation: 若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「挫屈安全係數」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Buckling safety factor” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。古典彈性理論預測的挫屈荷載對幾何缺陷非常敏感，實際殼體常只達到理論值的一小部分；混凝土的潛變會讓有效彈性模數隨時間下降，開裂也會降低勁度。因此設計者通常以折減係數把理論挫屈荷載降到實際可用值，再要求數倍的安全係數。Isler 一生建造近 1,400 座殼，研究者回推其殼平均厚度約 10 cm，正是在挫屈與材料用量之間取得平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「挫屈安全係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing; buckling governs: under compression, wherever local curvature drops or thickness is insufficient, the surface can suddenly snap inward. The classical elastic buckling load is very sensitive to geometric imperfections, and real shells often reach only a fraction of it; concrete creep lowers the effective modulus with time and cracking also reduces stiffness. Designers therefore apply knock-down factors to bring the theoretical buckling load to a usable value and then require a safety factor of several. Isler built nearly 1,400 shells, and researchers estimate his shells averaged about 10 cm thick, a balance between buckling and material use. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Buckling safety factor” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「挫屈安全係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Buckling safety factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性
knowledge.text: 薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。古典彈性理論預測的挫屈荷載對幾何缺陷非常敏感，實際殼體常只達到理論值的一小部分；混凝土的潛變會讓有效彈性模數隨時間下降，開裂也會降低勁度。
knowledge.textEn: Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing; buckling governs: under compression, wherever local curvature drops or thickness is insufficient, the surface can suddenly snap inward. The classical elastic buckling load is very sensitive to geometric imperfections, and real shells often reach only a fraction of it; concrete creep lowers the effective modulus with time and cracking also reduces stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity" is correct?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。
optionsEn: Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing; buckling governs: under compression, wherever local curvature drops or thickness is insufficient, the surface can suddenly snap inward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「挫屈安全係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Buckling safety factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。E = 30,000 MPa、t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002 時 p_cr ≈ 141 kPa；考慮缺陷 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3），折減後約 14.1 kPa。自重 1.92 kPa 加雪 1.0 kPa，安全係數 ≈ 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8；厚度減為 60 mm 時 p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)². With E = 30,000 MPa and t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002, p_cr ≈ 141 kPa; an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) bring it to about 14.1 kPa. With self-weight 1.92 kPa plus 1.0 kPa snow the safety factor is about 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8; at 60 mm thickness p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。E = 30,000 MPa、t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002 時 p_cr ≈ 141 kPa；考慮缺陷 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3），折減後約 14.1 kPa。自重 1.92 kPa 加雪 1.0 kPa，安全係數 ≈ 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8；厚度減為 60 mm 時 p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)². With E = 30,000 MPa and t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002, p_cr ≈ 141 kPa; an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) bring it to about 14.1 kPa. With self-weight 1.92 kPa plus 1.0 kPa snow the safety factor is about 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8; at 60 mm thickness p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity", which statement holds?
options: 球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。
柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。
薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。
optionsEn: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)².
A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation.
A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「挫屈安全係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Buckling safety factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。必要時以縮尺模型做破壞試驗驗證形狀選擇。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude. Where needed, verify the form choice with scale-model tests to failure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：挫屈檢核須明列折減係數、潛變假設與所用初始缺陷幅值，並與施工規範的幾何容許誤差連動：若施工單位無法達成該容許誤差，就必須回頭加厚殼板或加肋，而不是放寬驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Buckling checks should state the knock-down factor, creep assumption and imperfection amplitude used, tied to the construction geometry tolerance; if the builder cannot achieve that tolerance, thicken or rib the shell rather than relax acceptance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。必要時以縮尺模型做破壞試驗驗證形狀選擇。
knowledge.textEn: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude. Where needed, verify the form choice with scale-model tests to failure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 挫屈檢核須明列折減係數、潛變假設與所用初始缺陷幅值，並與施工規範的幾何容許誤差連動：若施工單位無法達成該容許誤差，就必須回頭加厚殼板或加肋，而不是放寬驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Buckling checks should state the knock-down factor, creep assumption and imperfection amplitude used, tied to the construction geometry tolerance; if the builder cannot achieve that tolerance, thicken or rib the shell rather than relax acceptance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。
薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus.
Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
quiz.explanation: 以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「挫屈安全係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Buckling safety factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Isler 一生建造近 1,400 座殼，研究者回推其殼平均厚度約 10 cm，正是在挫屈與材料用量之間取得平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Isler built nearly 1,400 shells, and researchers estimate his shells averaged about 10 cm thick, a balance between buckling and material use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。
knowledge.textEn: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator.
quiz.explanation: 淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
